    Enum representing the priority levels for an item.

    Represents a machine that performs a specific operation for a given amount of time.
    MachineTest

    Represents the utilization statistics of a machine, including its total operational time, utilization percentage, and percentage of time spent on a specific type of operation.

    Unit tests for the MachineUtilization class.
